title: com.archlucid.authority.run.completed
description: Service Bus message after an authority run commits successfully (canonical com.archlucid.authority.run.completed; legacy V1 type alias supported).

previousRunId.description: Prior committed run in the same tenant/workspace/project scope with a golden manifest, when one exists.

structuralExecutionMode.description: CG-093 — INV-002 structural execution mode stamped on the run at finalize.

workingCareerRehearsalDoor.description: CG-093 — CG-019 Working Career vs Rehearsal door captured at first execute.

careerComplete.description: CG-093 — true only when Career door + Real mode on a non-sample run; consumers must not infer Career from HTTP 200 alone.

findings.description: Optional per-finding deep links for operators and webhook consumers (additive; absent when no findings).
